articles.title: Viral Bonnet Drama in Maharashtra: Woman Climbs Onto Moving Car After Daughter's Court Marriage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic incident was reported from Shrirampur city in Maharashtra's Ahilyanagar district, where a woman climbed onto the bonnet of a moving car in an apparent attempt to stop her daughter and son-in-law after court proceedings related to their marriage.

body.html:
A dramatic incident was reported from Shrirampur city in Maharashtra's Ahilyanagar district, where a woman climbed onto the bonnet of a moving car in an apparent attempt to stop her daughter and son-in-law after court proceedings related to their marriage.

The incident, captured on video, has gone viral on social media. The footage shows the woman sitting on the bonnet of the moving car and repeatedly hitting the windshield with her slipper while the driver continues driving.

According to preliminary information, the woman's daughter had recently eloped and married a young man against her family's wishes. The couple had appeared before a court in Shrirampur to complete legal formalities related to their marriage.

After the court proceedings concluded, the couple left in a car. The woman's mother allegedly tried to stop the vehicle, but when it did not stop, she climbed onto the bonnet in a desperate attempt to prevent it from leaving.

Police said the woman refused to get off the bonnet, leaving the couple inside the car anxious. To avoid any untoward incident, the driver took the vehicle directly to the Shrirampur City Police Station.

A large crowd, including relatives from both families and local residents, gathered outside the police station, creating tension for some time. Police intervened, brought the situation under control and counselled both families in an attempt to resolve the dispute peacefully.

No formal complaint or FIR has been registered so far. Police said the matter is under investigation.

The viral video has sparked widespread reactions online, with many raising concerns over public safety and the risks involved in the incident.

articles.title: Caught on CCTV: Man Allegedly pushed Cat From 12th Floor in Ambernath, Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident of alleged animal cruelty has come to light in Maharashtra's Ambernath, where a man was reportedly caught on CCTV throwing a cat from the 12th floor of a residential building. The incident occurred at Royal Flora Phase Two.

body.html:
A shocking incident of alleged animal cruelty has come to light in Maharashtra's Ambernath, where a man was reportedly caught on CCTV throwing a cat from the 12th floor of a residential building.

The incident occurred at Royal Flora Phase Two. According to reports, the cat was sitting in the common area on the 12th floor when an elderly man allegedly approached it and pushed the animal over the edge of the building.

The CCTV footage of the incident has gone viral on social media, triggering widespread outrage among animal lovers and activists. Many have demanded strict action against the person responsible for the alleged act of cruelty.

Animal rights activists have urged the authorities to investigate the incident and take appropriate legal action. Police are expected to examine the CCTV footage and gather further details.

It is yet to be confirmed whether a case has been registered or any action has been taken against the accused.

articles.title: Husband Beats Wife With Helmet on Road in Anuppur, Viral Video Sparks Police Action
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video has surfaced showing a husband allegedly beating his wife with a helmet in the middle of the road in the Bhalumada police station area of Anuppur district. Police registered a case against the accused husband on Sunday and have launched a search for him.

body.html:
A video has surfaced showing a husband allegedly beating his wife with a helmet in the middle of the road in the Bhalumada police station area of Anuppur district. Police registered a case against the accused husband on Sunday and have launched a search for him.

According to police, the incident took place on July 25 near Parasi village. The victim was walking on the road when her husband, Bhushan Yadav, arrived on a bike and allegedly assaulted her. In the video, he is seen pulling her hair and hitting her with a helmet. The blow caused a head injury, bleeding and temporary loss of consciousness.

After the incident, the woman approached the Bhalumada police station and filed a complaint. She was also medically examined. A case has been registered against 40-year-old Bhushan Yadav under Sections 229 and 115 of the Indian Penal Code. Head Constable Sapan Namdev said the accused is absconding and efforts are on to trace him.

The victim, who lives in a rented house in Parasi with her son and daughter, works as a Krishi Sakhi. She has been living separately from her husband for the past year. She alleged that Bhushan Yadav has been harassing her for a long time.

She also claimed that despite a marital dispute case pending in court and their separation, her husband continued to stalk, abuse and threaten to kill her. The woman further alleged that he had assaulted her several times earlier as well.

#Anuppur #MadhyaPradesh #ViralVideo #DomesticViolence

articles.title: Truck Falls From Bridge in Nashik’s Sinnar MIDC, CCTV Captures Crash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A serious accident came to light in the Sinnar MIDC area of Nashik district, where a speeding truck reportedly lost control and fell from an Udaan bridge. The entire incident was captured on CCTV cameras.

body.html:
A serious accident came to light in the Sinnar MIDC area of Nashik district, where a speeding truck reportedly lost control and fell from an Udaan bridge. The entire incident was captured on CCTV cameras.

According to information received, the truck was moving from Udaan Pul towards the Sinnar MIDC campus when the driver suddenly lost control. The heavy vehicle hit the edge of the bridge and plunged down onto open ground below. The impact caused major damage to the truck and created panic in the area.

The sound of the crash drew a large crowd of bystanders to the spot, and local residents rushed to help. Police also reached the scene immediately and began relief work. However, official information on whether the truck driver was injured or whether there was any other loss of life has not yet been confirmed.

Police are investigating the incident further, and traffic has since been restored in the area.

articles.title: Samastipur Husband Catches Wife With Lover, Villagers Later Get Them Married
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a surprising turn of events in Bihar's Samastipur, a husband reportedly caught his wife with her lover and later arranged her marriage to him after a village panchayat.

body.html:
In a surprising turn of events in Bihar's Samastipur, a husband reportedly caught his wife with her lover and later arranged her marriage to him after a village panchayat.

The incident took place in the Karpurigram police station area, where the woman and her lover were allegedly caught by villagers while speaking near her house late at night. Following this, villagers and the woman's husband held a panchayat and decided to get the two married.

According to reports, the woman, Anuradha Kumari, a resident of Khagaria, had enrolled in an ANM college in Singhia Khurd village around one-and-a-half years ago. During that period, she developed a relationship with Manohar Kumar, a college staff member, and later married him about six months ago. Manohar was already married and has two children.

It is also being reported that Anuradha had an earlier relationship with Pannalal Yadav, a resident of Chak Pahad village under Tajpur police station area, who is also married and has two children, including a 12-year-old daughter and a nine-year-old son.

Pannalal said the two had first met about 10 years ago in Khagaria, where both studied and later lost contact after returning home. He said they reconnected after Anuradha joined the nursing course in Singhia, and their talks resumed even after her marriage to Manohar.

During the panchayat, a consensus was reportedly reached to marry Anuradha to Pannalal in the presence of Manohar. The unusual development has drawn attention in the area.

articles.title: Relatives Set Private Hospital Reception on Fire in Kothagudem After Woman's Death
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tension prevailed at a private hospital in Bhadradri Kothagudem district on Saturday after relatives of a deceased patient allegedly set fire to the reception area, accusing the hospital staff of medical negligence.

body.html:
Tension prevailed at a private hospital in Bhadradri Kothagudem district on Saturday after relatives of a deceased patient allegedly set fire to the reception area, accusing the hospital staff of medical negligence.

The deceased was identified as Venkataramana, a tribal Sarpanch from Dantelaboru village in Palvoncha mandal. She had been admitted to the hospital a few days earlier after falling ill and died while undergoing treatment.

Her family alleged that the doctors failed to give a clear explanation about her death and acted negligently. Her husband claimed that the hospital staff shifted her to a government hospital in Khammam only after her condition worsened. He also alleged that an overdose of medication led to her death.

According to police, Venkataramana had complained of fever due to an infection two days earlier and died on Friday night. Her family reportedly came to know about her death only on Saturday morning.

Angered by the hospital's response, the family staged a protest on the premises, and one of the relatives allegedly tried to set the reception counter on fire. Police rushed to the spot, doused the flames and brought the situation under control.

Police said no complaint was received from the hospital regarding the fire, so no case had been registered at that stage. Further investigation is underway.

#BhadradriKothagudem #HospitalFire #MedicalNegligence

articles.title: Congress Stages Protest Over Smart Meters, Rising Power Bills in Chhattisgarh’s Pandaria
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Congress Committee in Pandaria block of Chhattisgarh’s Kawardha district staged a protest on Saturday in front of the Pandatarai Electricity Office, demanding action on rising electricity bills, complaints over smart meters, and improvements in the power supply system.

body.html:
The Congress Committee in Pandaria block of Chhattisgarh’s Kawardha district staged a protest on Saturday in front of the Pandatarai Electricity Office, demanding action on rising electricity bills, complaints over smart meters, and improvements in the power supply system.

During the protest, Congress workers and a large number of villagers arrived with their household electricity meters and threw several of them inside the electricity office premises in protest. They also submitted a six-point memorandum to the Governor seeking immediate action.

Villagers alleged that electricity bills have increased sharply after the installation of smart meters. They claimed that the meters are recording higher units than actual consumption, adding to the financial burden on consumers without any relief.

The memorandum demanded cancellation of incorrect and inflated bills after an impartial inquiry, issuance of fresh bills based on actual consumption, a ban on the forced installation of smart meters, and a technical audit of existing meters.

The Congress also sought withdrawal of the electricity tariff hike, replacement of damaged wires, poles and transformers, resolution of low-voltage problems, timely repair work during faults, and a ban on unannounced power cuts.

The memorandum was submitted to the Governor through the Assistant Engineer of the CSPDCL Distribution Centre. The Congress warned that if its demands are not met, the agitation will be intensified further.

#Chhattisgarh #Kawardha #Pandaria #SmartMeters

articles.title: Night of Vandalism in Bhopal: Bike-Borne Miscreants Smash Vehicle Windows in Katara Hills Colony
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Panic has gripped a colony in Bhopal’s Katara Hills police station area after two bike-borne miscreants allegedly smashed the windows of parked vehicles with stones late Saturday night.

body.html:
Panic has gripped a colony in Bhopal’s Katara Hills police station area after two bike-borne miscreants allegedly smashed the windows of parked vehicles with stones late Saturday night.

The incident, which was captured on CCTV cameras installed in the area, has prompted police to launch a search for the accused.

According to reports, two young men arrived on a bike and targeted four-wheelers parked outside homes and along the roadside. They allegedly broke the windows of four vehicles one by one with stones before fleeing the spot.

When vehicle owners stepped out of their homes in the morning, they were shocked to find the damaged vehicles and shattered glass scattered around. They then informed the police.

Police from the Katara Hills station reached the spot and inspected the scene. CCTV footage from the area reportedly shows two bike riders carrying out the vandalism. An FIR has been registered against unidentified persons, and efforts are underway to identify the accused.

Local residents have expressed concern over the rising movement of antisocial elements in the area late at night and have demanded increased police patrolling and strict action.

#Bhopal #KataraHills #CCTV #ViralVideo #VehicleDamage

articles.title: CCTV Captures Horror Crash on NH 66: Private Bus Overturns in Kuttippuram, One Dead, Over 26 Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: CCTV footage captured the moment a private bus on National Highway 66 at Kuttippuram overturned on Sunday, leaving one person dead and more than 26 others injured, including three critically.

body.html:
CCTV footage captured the moment a private bus on National Highway 66 at Kuttippuram overturned on Sunday, leaving one person dead and more than 26 others injured, including three critically.

The bus reportedly crashed through the road divider, skidded for nearly 25 metres and flipped onto the opposite carriageway. After the impact, the vehicle was left perched on a concrete roadside barrier, with its undercarriage torn apart. One side of the bus also came to rest on top of a parked car on the opposite side of the road.

The deceased has been identified as Vaishnav, a native of Peruvayal in Kozhikode. The injured passengers were taken to nearby hospitals for treatment.

Passengers said panic broke out after the accident as diesel began leaking inside the overturned bus, making it difficult for people to escape. Local residents also joined the rescue efforts and helped evacuate passengers from the wreckage.

Police said the stretch is known to be accident-prone. The exact cause of the crash is yet to be established, though a senior officer said the bus may have been speeding and rain could also have contributed to the accident.

According to eyewitnesses, the bus lost control, hit the divider and overturned with such force that it split into two parts. Further investigation is underway.

#Kerala #Kuttippuram #NH66 #BusAccident #RoadAccident

articles.title: Intoxicated Youths Ride Motorcycle Into BRIMS Emergency Ward, Police Step in
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Panic gripped the Bidar Institute of Medical Sciences (BRIMS) District Hospital late on Friday night after two allegedly intoxicated youths rode a motorcycle into the Emergency Ward, reportedly putting patients and medical staff at risk.

body.html:
Panic gripped the Bidar Institute of Medical Sciences (BRIMS) District Hospital late on Friday night after two allegedly intoxicated youths rode a motorcycle into the Emergency Ward, reportedly putting patients and medical staff at risk.

According to hospital sources, the duo arrived claiming that one of them was suffering from a severe headache. Instead of following the regular admission process, they allegedly rode the motorcycle directly into the Emergency Ward, disrupting the functioning of the critical care unit.

Police personnel deployed at the hospital immediately intervened and stopped the motorcycle. The youths allegedly resisted the police before being overpowered and taken into custody. Police reportedly used mild force to bring the situation under control.

A case has been registered, and further legal action is underway. Police are investigating the incident.

#BRIMS #Bidar #Hospital #EmergencyWard #ViralVideo
